question: The Karakoram pass, the mountain pass which lies between India and China, is in close proximity to:
solution:
The Correct answer is **__Kargil.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Karakoram Pass **straddles the boundary between India and China and is located about 100 kilometers west of the **China-Pakistan-India tripoint.**
 
• The **Karakoram Pass i**s a hill pass in the middle of **India and China, lying in the Karakoram Mountain Range. **
 
• It is the tallest pass on the very old caravan path in the midst of** Leh in Ladakh and Yarkand in the Tarim Valley.**
 
• The name Karakoram was used in the early 20th century, for example by Kenneth Mason, for the range now known as the **Baltoro Muztagh.**
